title: PPIA-14 Authority and Hidden-Information Boundary Matrix

authority_domains.owner: application work orders and owner gates

hidden_information_boundaries.rule: Do not reveal that a hidden resource exists, its stable ID, type, name, or denial-specific reason.
Only fields already authorized for this subject may influence copy or variables.
Hidden objects/issues/participants contribute no visible counts, facets, result totals, empty-state distinctions, or ranking signals.
Do not expose protected existence through distinctive timing, retry cadence, polling, spinner duration, or transition labels.
User-safe reason codes may be shown only when upstream policy permits; policy internals remain hidden.
An affordance must not prove existence or imply authority; mutation retry requires an idempotency/status contract.
Pending/denied/approved status may be shown only when the subject is authorized to know the proposal exists.
Never bind secrets, hidden payloads, raw provider values, unauthorized logs, policy internals, or hidden issue counts into copy/support context.
Issue/help context inherits F025 deny/exclude defaults and report-bound authorization.
Copy, notification, export and optional AI context cannot reintroduce filtered information.
Plural/count variables and interpolation inputs may only contain already-disclosable values.
hidden_information_boundaries.safe_projection: no hidden values or secret-derived grammar

equivalence_rule: When existence is protected, the externally observable copy state, actions, counts/shape and timing/recovery behavior must not let the subject distinguish 'missing' from 'exists but hidden/revoked/out-of-scope'.
blocking_invariants: Permission and entitlement projection precede copy selection and every derivative.
Hidden objects and fields contribute no visible counts, names, types, reasons, timing signals, diagnostics, suggestions, retries or support context.
Status unknown is not failure and never authorizes a blind mutation retry.
Local draft or offline state never implies authoritative mutation.
An accepted durable Event is distinct from a lagging projection.
Microcopy never grants permissions, changes gameplay, resolves conflicts, creates Pack lifecycle truth, promotes canonical content or activates application runtime.
F024 Pack Lifecycle remains an explicit unresolved source gap.
No application runtime, STAGE-A-A2, release, deployment, tester, paid-service or production state is activated.
